# tests/fixtures/trendlyne

Real Trendlyne answers for Reliance Industries, saved on 5 October 2026 during the first-month checks (get_stock_parameter_values, two calls). Used by tests/unit/test_fundamentals_normaliser.py so the Trendlyne parser is tested against the real format without using any of the plan's calls.

These files hold only Trendlyne's answers (labels and figures). They never hold the Trendlyne URL or its token.
